title: Nightly Build Update Available
message: A new GabAI build is ready with curated educational diagrams, perspective visual chips, fullscreen lightbox, and strictly enforced mandatory updates.
changelog:
• Curated Educational Diagrams: Direct Wikimedia Commons SVG/PNG diagrams (zero AI tokens, ad-free)
• Perspective Filter Chips: Instant toggle between Diagram, Microscopic, and Process views
• Fullscreen Lightbox: Tap diagram or expand icon for immersive view
• Strictly Enforced Updates: Removed 'Maybe Later' to guarantee all devices run latest build
